records.title: SuperTuxKart
records.setupBurden: Download official stable release; no compiler needed.
caveats: The official 24 Oct 2026 notice reports the addons site offline for security reasons. Online addons may be unavailable. Evolution is a separate in-development project.

records.title: Beyond All Reason
records.setupBurden: Higher: launcher followed by asset updates; 12 GB RAM minimum; SSD advised.
caveats: Alpha+; Windows and Linux, not macOS.
Online play requires an account with a valid email.
Allow 20 GB available space according to the official guide; this is a native download, not browser play.
